sentences.text: Matter pertains to domestic dispute and allegation are in respect of offence under Sections 498A, 294, 323, 506 and 34 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
After due deliberations and discussion with the parties, it appears that mediation be given a chance so that either parties may reunite or would find the modalities for peaceful departure.

Therefore,
Shri Padam Singh, Advocate, who is a trained Mediator, is requested to act as Mediator in the matter.
Mediation has immense potential to bring well-being to the litigating parties.
In-fact mediation is like "Mediation in Litigation" so as to bring peace and finality to the litigation.

Parties are directed to appear before learned mediator as per the mutually convenient time given by him and would continue to appear as and when required or suggested by the Mediator with the consent of the parties.
Mediator shall explore the possibility of domestic reunion or peaceful separation of the parties.
Mediation proceedings be concluded within two months.
Parties may raise all the submissions before the Mediator as per law.
List this case in the month of May, 2024.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE Anil*
